description: Not a reply, and not part of the examples' session: what a peer sends as soon as it has a call it will run, ahead of the call's own answer. It says the call's `id`. A host fails a call that has neither this nor an answer within 5 s, however long it may run after that, which is how a host that's gone costs at most that. Only a peer whose `daemon.hello` said `accepts_calls: true` sends it: `vibed.sock` on a link, for the agent calls.
